lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-intensity circular pixel clusters is visible on the mid-lateral flank, transitioning from a high density of small spots on the anterior head region to larger, more widely spaced spots arranged in vertical columns posterior to the gills.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of circular blobs to form a regular, checkerboard-like grid of anchor nodes across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper lateral and dorsal surfaces, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance on the ridge apex to distinct shadowing immediately below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin shows a high density of small, high-luminance spots distributed uniformly across the visible silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two small, dark-colored commensal organisms (remoras) visible in the water column immediately ventral to the pectoral fin and mid-body region.
